reason: This is primarily a Git utility plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web interface, focused on in-browser version control workflows: inspecting changes, staging/committing, reverting, and syncing with remotes. Evidence from the README and package metadata shows a dedicated sidebar-style Git panel plus host-side git services, so it is classified as a files/terminal-style productivity utility rather than research, media, or document processing tool.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 的 Web UI 中提供一个 Git 图形化侧边栏，可查看仓库改动并在浏览器里进行暂存、提交和回退等版本控制操作。
summaries.en: This plugin adds a Git graphical sidebar to DeepSeek Harness Web UI, letting you review repository changes and perform version-control actions like staging, committing, and reverting from the browser.

capabilities: Display git status, file changes, and commit history in-browser
Execute workspace file operations through git actions (stage/unstage, commit, discard, revert)
Perform repository-level git commands via host runtime (including remote sync commands)
Show local file previews and color-coded change status in a file tree
Track agent/tool file-modification activity for session-based timeline
Poll session/cwd state and coordinate UI operations with running sessions

reasons.code: README describes it as a Git graphical interface plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI with core actions view, stage, commit, and revert.
Features list includes staged/modified/untracked views, one-click stage/unstage/discard/delete, commit log with revert, and pull/push/fetch + add remote.
Package metadata sets dsh.client.platform to web and injects web UI sidebar modules, showing browser-side panel integration.
Tree includes lib/runner.js and lib/parse.js, indicating a host-side git execution/parsing service plus browser client UI modules.
Package description explicitly mentions stage/commit/branch/merge/log/pull/push/stash/revert from browser.
